name: Draft Beer (Seasonal)
description:
Our rotating seasonal draft beer, featuring unique and limited-time brews. Available in two sizes:
• Half Pint (265ml): ¥880
• Pint (480ml): ¥1,330

Ask our staff about the current seasonal selection and its special characteristics.

name: Minoh Weizen (Bottle)
description: A classic German-style wheat beer brewed by Minoh Brewery. Cloudy and golden, with bright banana and clove aromas, a soft creamy mouthfeel, and a refreshing, slightly tart finish.

name: Minoh Pilsner (Bottle)
description: A crisp, clean Czech-style pilsner with delicate noble hop bitterness. Light straw color, fine carbonation, and a dry, snappy finish make it extremely drinkable.

name: Minoh Stout (Bottle)
description: A full-bodied, dark stout with notes of coffee, cocoa, and roasted malt. Silky smooth, with a lingering roast character and a creamy head that highlights its rich flavor.

name: Minoh Pale Ale (Bottle)
description: A balanced American-style pale ale featuring citrusy hop aroma and a gentle malt backbone. Golden amber color, medium body, with a crisp, refreshing finish.

name: Osaru IPA (Bottle)
description: Minoh Brewery's signature IPA, nicknamed "Osaru." Bursting with tropical fruit and pine aromas, this bold, hoppy beer delivers a smooth bitterness and a bright, lingering finish.

name: Minoh W-IPA (Bottle)
description: A powerful double IPA with extra hop charge for intense citrus, resin, and mango flavors. Higher ABV balanced by a smooth malt body, delivering a satisfying, long-lasting hop finish.

name: Orizé Malt Pale Ale
description: Bronze Medal Winner – Gluten-Free Category, International Beer Cup 2024. Crafted using a world-first innovation: koji-fermented rice malt. This beer is brewed with Orizé Malt, a unique ingredient made by cultivating koji on germinated rice husks, then kiln-drying them to bring out a deep, roasted character. The result is a gluten-free craft beer with exceptional complexity and depth.

name: JAPANESE WHITE No.9
description: Orizé Brewing's Signature Gluten-Free White Ale, Reimagined. This world-first beer is brewed entirely without malt, using rice koji as its core ingredient. A bold evolution of Orizé Brewing's flagship Japanese White, this No.9 edition undergoes primary fermentation in oak barrels, imparting a depth and complexity not achieved through standard barrel aging.

name: BLACK HEAD IPA
description: A Bold, Gluten-Free Luchuensis Sour IPA Brewed with Rice Koji. A truly unique sour IPA, brewed with a combination of black koji and kiln-dried rice koji. This innovative beer delivers a vivid tropical tartness, as if fresh island fruits were squeezed right into the glass.

name: PARALLEL IPA
description: Gluten-Free Rice-Based IPA from Another World. Crafted using a world-first fermentation technique with Orizé Malt—rice malt made by cultivating koji on germinated rice husks. PARALLEL IPA offers fruity aromas reminiscent of yellow peach and pear, paired with a clean bitterness that surprises with its depth.

name: ORYZAE GOLDEN ALE
description: High-ABV Belgian-Style Golden Ale – Brewed Without Malt, Using Rice Koji. A bold, golden ale brewed without any malt—only rice koji is used as the fermentation base. This beer undergoes primary fermentation in oak barrels, followed by bottle conditioning for a naturally carbonated finish.

name: Happy Hour Drink
description: Enjoy our Happy Hour pricing on a selection of drinks — draft beer, Akishika sake, Akishika highball, or wine. All at the same relaxed price. Ask our staff for the current Happy Hour window.
